page.overview:
Who is British Police Officers?

The British Police Officers are characters in Cars 2. The officers are Ford Mondeos wearing the hat of the London police.

They are seen stationed at various points around the World Grand Prix circuit. When Mater lands at Buckingham Palace in front of the Queen with a bomb on him, many officers flock to protect the Queen and hold back the crowds. They then arrest Miles Axlerod after Mater exposes him.
